title: Patch: every page Google should index answers 200 and is its own canonical (Search Console: "Page with redirect", "Alternate page with proper canonical tag")
thread:
**Issue #3485 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3485: Patch: every page Google should index answers 200 and is its own canonical (Search Console: "Page with redirect", "Alternate page with proper canonical tag")
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What happens

Google Search Console reported (2026-11-09) that some jackioh.com pages are not indexed, for two new reasons. The URLs it lists (last crawled):

**Alternate page with proper canonical tag**

| URL | Crawled |
|---|---|
| `http://jackioh.com/replays` | Nov 6, 2026 |
| `http://jackioh.com/` | Nov 4, 2026 |
| `http://jackioh.com/decks` | Oct 29, 2026 |
| `http://jackioh.com/play` | Oct 29, 2026 |
| `http://jackioh.com/creator` | Oct 29, 2026 |
| `http://jackioh.com/terms` | Oct 28, 2026 |
| `http://jackioh.com/accessibility` | Oct 25, 2026 |

**Page with redirect**

| URL | Crawled |
|---|---|
| `http://jackioh.com/together` | Oct 19, 2026 |
| `https://jackioh.com/creator` | Oct 19, 2026 |
| `https://jackioh.com/play` | Oct 19, 2026 |
| `https://jackioh.com/decks` | Oct 18, 2026 |
| `https://jackioh.com/together` | Oct 18, 2026 |

## Diagnosis (from reading the tree; confirm before fixing)

**1. `http://` is served, not redirected to `https://`.** Every URL in the canonical bucket is plain `http://`: Cloudflare answers it with the page itself (200), whose `<link rel="canonical">` names the `https://` address (`canonicalUrlFor`, `apps/web/src/net/head.ts`), so Google files the `http://` copy as an alternate. Nothing in the tree turns on "Always Use HTTPS" or sends `Strict-Transport-Security`: `infra/cloudflare.tf` has no zone setting for it and `apps/web/public/_headers` no HSTS header. Static assets never reach the Worker (`run_worker_first` covers only `/api/*`, `/ws/*` and the module), so the Worker cannot redirect them.

**2. The account-gated screens redirect a signed-out visitor to `/login` in JavaScript.** `/play`, `/decks` and `/together` are served 200 by `/` (`_redirects`), then the client sends an anonymous visitor (Googlebot) to `/login` with `navigate(…, { replace: true })` (`redirectFor` and `Gated` in `apps/web/src/main.tsx`; `apps/web/src/routes/decks.tsx:117`). Google renders the page and records the redirect. That redirect is right for players, but these pages have nothing to index for a crawler, and unlike `/account`, `/invite`, `/match/` and `/series/` they are not in `apps/web/public/robots.txt`'s `Disallow` list.

**3. `/creator` is no route.** It is not in `paths` (`apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`), `_redirects` or git history under `apps/web`, so it is a link from somewhere outside. It should answer the 404 page (404 status, noindex, R3127000) and drop out on its own; confirm that it does and that nothing in the tree links to it.

## What should happen

Every URL the site wants indexed (each page in `PUBLIC_PAGES`, `apps/web/static-pages.ts`, as listed in `sitemap.xml`) is reached only at its `https://` address, answers 200 and is its own canonical. `http://` answers a permanent redirect to `https://`. The account-gated screens are kept out of the index on purpose, not found and then dropped as redirects.

## What to do

1. **HTTPS:** turn on Cloudflare's Always Use HTTPS for the `jackioh.com` zone as Terraform in `infra/cloudflare.tf` (`infra/README.md`: the hosts' dashboard settings live there, #1708), and add `Strict-Transport-Security` for production in `apps/web/public/_headers` (not for staging or `*.workers.dev` if that would break `promote-production.yml`'s live check; check). If applying the Terraform needs a person, say so in the pull request and in the handoff.
2. **Gated screens:** add `/play`, `/decks` and `/together` (and any other screen `Gated` wraps with no public content: `/collection`, `/shop`, `/leaderboard`, …; read `main.tsx`) to `robots.txt`'s `Disallow`, matching how `/account` is handled. Keep them out of `sitemap.xml` (they are today). Do not remove the redirect.
3. **`/creator`:** confirm it gets the 404 page; no change expected.
4. **A test that holds it:** beside `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-serve.test.ts`, `deploy-routes.test.ts` and `static-pages.test.ts`: every `sitemap.xml` URL is `https://`, has a 200 rule under `_redirects`, and is its own canonical; and no gated route is in the sitemap and every one is disallowed in `robots.txt`.
5. Write down in a comment beside the rule (in `robots.txt` or `_redirects`) why each gated screen is disallowed, so the next Search Console notice can be answered from the tree.

Out of scope: anything only the Cloudflare or Search Console dashboard can do (a person does that, e.g. "Validate fix" in Search Console after this ships).

## How to reproduce

`curl -sI http://jackioh.com/terms` (expect 200, not 301). Open `https://jackioh.com/decks` in a private window: the client moves to `/login`. Locally: `pnpm --dir apps/web build`, then read `apps/web/dist/sitemap.xml`, `apps/web/dist/robots.txt`, `apps/web/dist/_redirects` and each page's `<link rel="canonical">`.

## Where

The client (`apps/web`: `public/robots.txt`, `public/_headers`, `public/_redirects`, `static-pages.ts`, `src/net/head.ts`, `src/main.tsx`) and `infra/cloudflare.tf`.

Related: #587 (every public page ships its own HTML), #696 (crawlers pointed at the staging host), #3127 (the 404 page).

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42628567110)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Every page the site wants indexed (each entry of `PUBLIC_PAGES` in `apps/web/static-pages.ts`, as listed in `sitemap.xml`) is served only at its `https://` address, answers 200, and names itself as its own canonical. Plain `http://` answers a permanent redirect to `https://` via Cloudflare's Always Use HTTPS (Terraform) plus an HSTS header. The account-gated screens (`/play`, `/decks`, `/together`, and every other screen `Gated` wraps with no public content) are kept out of the index by `robots.txt`, keep their client-side redirect, and stay out of the sitemap. `/creator` is confirmed to be no route and to fall through to the 404 page, with no change.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `infra/cloudflare.tf` | change | New `cloudflare_zone_setting.always_use_https` resource plus comment |
| `apps/web/public/_headers` | change | `Strict-Transport-Security` line in the `/*` block plus comment |
| `apps/web/public/robots.txt` | change | New `Disallow` lines with a why-comment |
| `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` | change | Expect the HSTS header in the `/*` block |
| `apps/web/src/net/search-index.test.ts` | new | The holding test: sitemap-canonical-redirects consistency, gated-out-of-sitemap, gated-disallowed, `/creator`-is-404 |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` (forbidden); `crates/`, `apps/edge`, `e2e/` (nothing there changes); `spec/` and rulings (this is an ops/SEO change, no Hearthstone-semantics decision, so no new ruling note); `apps/web/public/_redirects`, `apps/web/src/main.tsx`, `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`, `apps/web/src/net/head.ts`, `apps/web/static-pages.ts` (verified, left as-is; the redirect stays). Context issues only: #587, #696, #3127. No spec section governs this change.

## Steps

1. Confirm the diagnosis read-only. Run `grep -rn '"/creator\|/creator' apps/web/src apps/web/public apps/web/static-pages.ts apps/web/index.html` and check the hits are only unrelated words (the game-event `creator` field, "card creator" prose in `src/patches/releases.ts`): no `/creator` entry in `paths` (`apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`), no rule in `public/_redirects`, no link. Read the route switch in `apps/web/src/main.tsx` (~lines 620–850) and list every `Gated` screen: `/invite`, `/decks`, `/play`, `/account`, `/leaderboard`, `/collection`, `/shop`, `/together`, `/match/:id`, `/series/:id`, `/watch/:id`, `/duos/:id`. Note `/play`'s exception (anonymous visitor without a room link sees the public hub, R1578000) — it still gets disallowed since it is not a `PUBLIC_PAGES` page and ships no static HTML. Note `/replays` (public device lists, ungated) and `/purchases` (public page, not in the sitemap) stay allowed and unchanged, as do `/reset-password` and `/dungeon/stats` (not `Gated`-wrapped, outside this task's scope).
2. Check the HSTS blast radius before writing it. Read the `check the live site` step of `.github/workflows/promote-production.yml`: it curls `https://jackioh.com` and the `workers.dev` address over HTTPS and asserts bundle sign-in content, `/decks` 200, a `Content-Security-Policy` header, and `/not-a-page` 404. An extra response header breaks none of that, so one unconditional HSTS line in `public/_headers` (which ships identically to production, staging, and `workers.dev`) is safe; record this finding in the header comment.
3. In `infra/cloudflare.tf`, after the `cloudflare_workers_custom_domain.jackioh_com` block and its `import` block, add:
   ```hcl
   # #3485: Cloudflare answered http://jackioh.com with the page itself, so Google filed it
   # as an alternate of the https:// canonical. Always Use HTTPS answers every http request
   # with a 301 to https instead; public/_headers' HSTS keeps browsers there. This updates the
   # zone's existing setting in place (no import block: there is no separate object to import).
   # A person runs plan/apply with the tokens (README.md, Running it).
   resource "cloudflare_zone_setting" "always_use_https" {
     zone_id    = data.cloudflare_zone.jackioh.id
     setting_id = "always_use_https"
     value      = "on"
   }
   ```
   Copy the `zone_id = data.cloudflare_zone.jackioh.id` spelling from the DNS resources above it. No `import` block.
4. In `apps/web/public/_headers`, in the `/*` block after the `Permissions-Policy` line, add `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains`, and a comment above the block noting it pairs with Always Use HTTPS (`infra/cloudflare.tf`), ships to staging and `workers.dev` deliberately (all HTTPS-only; the promote live check is unaffected per step 2), and omits `preload` (never submitted). Copy the two-space indent of the neighboring header lines.
5. In `apps/web/public/robots.txt`, keep the existing lines and extend to:
   ```
   User-agent: *
   Allow: /
   # #3485: account-gated screens have nothing to index for a signed-out crawler (the
   # client sends it to /login in JS, which Search Console records as "Page with
   # redirect"), so they are kept out of the index on purpose. They stay out of
   # sitemap.xml and keep their redirect; src/net/search-index.test.ts holds this list
   # to main.tsx's Gated screens.
   Disallow: /account
   Disallow: /invite
   Disallow: /play
   Disallow: /decks
   Disallow: /together
   Disallow: /leaderboard
   Disallow: /collection
   Disallow: /shop
   Disallow: /match/
   Disallow: /series/
   Disallow: /watch/
   Disallow: /duos/

   Sitemap: https://staging.jackioh.com/sitemap.xml
   ```
   Fixed screens use the `/account` spelling, id-addressed screens the `/match/` prefix spelling. The `Sitemap:` line is untouched (the build rewrites its host per origin).
6. In `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`, in the `sends the security headers on every path` test, append `"strict-transport-security"` to the expected key list after `"permissions-policy"`, and add `expect(headers.get("strict-transport-security")).toBe("max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains");`. Nothing else in that file changes (still three blocks, same CSP).
7. Create `apps/web/src/net/search-index.test.ts`. Copy the file-reading pattern from `cloudflare-serve.test.ts` (read `public/_redirects` into `[from, to, status]` rows; read `public/robots.txt` `Disallow:` values) and import `PUBLIC_PAGES` and `sitemapXml` from `../../static-pages.ts`, `canonicalUrlFor` from `./head.ts`, `paths` from `./navigate.ts`. Define the gated list as `[paths.invite, paths.decks, paths.play, paths.account, paths.leaderboard, paths.collection, paths.shop, paths.together]` plus the prefixes `["/match/", "/series/", "/watch/", "/duos/"]`. Write these tests:
   - `every sitemap URL is https and its own canonical`: `sitemapXml(PUBLIC_PAGES, "https://jackioh.com")` yields exactly `PUBLIC_PAGES.map((page) => \`https://jackioh.com${page.path}\`)`; each equals `canonicalUrlFor(page.path, "https://jackioh.com")`; every loc starts with `https://`.
   - `every sitemap page has a 200 rule`: `/` needs none (served directly); every other `PUBLIC_PAGES` path has a `_redirects` row `[path, path + "/", "200"]` (the emitted-page shape `cloudflare-serve.test.ts` pins).
   - `no gated route is in the sitemap`: no loc equals a fixed gated path or starts with a gated prefix, and `PUBLIC_PAGES` contains none of the fixed gated paths.
   - `every gated route is disallowed`: each fixed gated path matches a `Disallow` line by robots prefix rules (line equals the path or is a prefix of it); each gated prefix is itself a `Disallow` line.
   - `/creator falls to the 404 page`: no string value of `paths` is `/creator`; no `_redirects` row starts from `/creator` or `/creator/`; `canonicalUrlFor("/creator")` is `null`.
8. In the pull request body and handoff, say a person must run `terraform plan` / `terraform apply` from `infra/README.md` (needs `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`) after merge, and must click "Validate fix" in Search Console (dashboard-only, out of scope here).

## Tests

- New `apps/web/src/net/search-index.test.ts` tests (names as in step 7): sitemap-https-and-own-canonical; sitemap-pages-have-200-rules; gated-routes-not-in-sitemap; gated-routes-disallowed; creator-falls-to-404. Each fails without its corresponding change (wrong scheme, missing rule, gated path in sitemap or not disallowed, `/creator` routed).
- Updated `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` HSTS assertions fail without the `_headers` line.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/search-index.test.ts`, then the adjacent files `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/cloudflare-serve.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/deploy-routes.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/static-pages.test.ts`. If `terraform` is installed, also `terraform -chdir=infra fmt -check -recursive` and `terraform -chdir=infra init -backend=false` plus `validate`; otherwise CI covers those per `infra/README.md`.

## Done when

- [ ] `http://` redirect is Terraform (`cloudflare_zone_setting`, Always Use HTTPS on) and HSTS ships in `_headers` for production without breaking the promote live check.
- [ ] `/play`, `/decks`, `/together`, `/leaderboard`, `/collection`, `/shop`, `/watch/`, `/duos/` are disallowed with the why-comment; `/account`, `/invite`, `/match/`, `/series/` unchanged; all stay out of the sitemap with redirects kept.
- [ ] `/creator` verified as no route/link/rule, canonical `null`, covered by the new 404 test; no `_redirects` change.
- [ ] New holding test and updated config test pass; the four adjacent web test files pass; Terraform fmt/validate pass (locally or on CI); no ruling added so `spec check` needs no change.
- [ ] PR body and handoff note the person-run `terraform apply` and the Search Console "Validate fix" click.

## Risks

- HSTS `includeSubDomains` also pins `staging.` and `admin.` hosts: all are HTTPS-only, so harmless; `preload` is deliberately absent since the domain was never submitted.
- Always Use HTTPS changes `http://` from 200 to 301: intended; the issue's `curl -sI http://jackioh.com/terms` repro flips from 200 to 301 after a person applies it.
- `robots.txt` affects crawlers only; signed-in players and the client redirect are untouched. Adding `Disallow: /play` also keeps the anonymous hub out of the index, which matches the sitemap (it was never a `PUBLIC_PAGES` page).
- No engine, card, AI, server, or Worker code changes, so determinism, replay, hidden information, and the purity lints are unaffected; Terraform `plan`/`apply` stay manual per `infra/README.md`.

## Open questions

- Person-run apply: `terraform plan`/`apply` needs `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and may surface drift or an import the plan must stop for (per `infra/README.md`); a person does this after merge, then clicks "Validate fix" in Search Console. Nothing else needs a person.
````
